revision_note: After the first build, only native test-helper argument/validation logic and .tst definitions/calibrated criteria changed. Production generator, boundary sampling and flow equations are unchanged from M4. The final complete 19-test registered CTest batch uses ce05c35.
run_directory_note: 46e4da4 is the initial M5 candidate label; final tested revisions are recorded separately.

registered_regressions.working_directory_override: External per-test directories; native executables resolved by symlinks to their actual build targets.
registered_regressions.scheduler: CTest --parallel 8; PROCESSORS set to each exact .tst maximum rank count

inherited.purpose: M5 durable criteria inherited from closed M3/M4 evidence or analytical bounds, before M5 solver runs
inherited.flow_diagnostic_threshold_policy: Freeze the evolved bulk divergence and net-flux regression limits only after a manufactured-solution polynomial/timestep pilot; record its values and refinement separately from these fixed synthesis/partition bounds.

manufactured.scope: M3 two-mode manufactured full-3D case, p12, dt=0.01, t=0.1, fixed native solver settings; not a production HIT tolerance
manufactured.decision: The p12 dt=0.01 observed divergence and net flux fit these bounds; four timestep levels and a p14 check show decrease toward numerical error. Bounds are frozen before the fresh diagnostic regression is run. Algebraic generator tolerances remain separate.

limitations: Regression inputs are small manufactured/transient cases, not downstream physical decay validation.

Bulk divergence/flux limits apply to the specified manufactured p12 dt=0.01 case; the short mean-initialized stochastic H1D case has relative divergence about 1.29e-3 and requires later startup/resolution analysis.
Diagnostic/operator checks and checkpoint comparisons use native XML fields; HDF5 is disabled in this build.
Existing Tester serial-first/MPI-later launcher behavior is avoided by MPI-first ordering and explicit eight-rank scheduling, not changed by M5.
